reviews.text:
We entrusted our dog to Waggy for our two months in Paris and we loved it! Our senior dog was wonderfully well cared for. The daily walks and activities keep the dogs active and happy.

Sara and Maria are lovely people, and their love for dogs truly shines through. We highly recommend Waggy and will gladly return!

A fantastic place to leave your dogs with complete peace of mind!
Babka, our 5-month-old Coton de Tuléar, spends one day a week there when we're not working from home. She's always thrilled to go, and it's a real joy to see her so happy when she arrives at the door!

The team is wonderful, caring, and attentive to each dog's needs. Babka thrives, surrounded by lots of friends she can play with.

We highly recommend it!

This doggie daycare is the best! We were visiting Paris with our pup and finding this crèche was a god send so that we could sightsee. They were kind and communicative. They even sent pictures throughout the day! We felt like our girl was really well taken care of. If I could give more than five stars I would!

While in Paris for an award ceremony, we were also on our way back from vacation. We had no choice but to find someone to look after Paco, our dog, even though we don't particularly like leaving him. Unfortunately, dogs aren't allowed at the Dôme de Paris.

That's when we discovered the Waggy dog ​​daycare, and we just wanted to say thank you.

Thank you for your service, efficiency, and professionalism. Knowing that our companion was in good hands while we attended our event was incredibly reassuring.

The photos sent during his stay were a real bonus and allowed us to fully enjoy our day.

Some might say we're overly doting on our dog, but when you love your pet, knowing they're well cared for and well looked after is what matters most.

A huge thank you to the entire team for their kindness, and to the dog nannies for their professionalism and compassion. Best of luck to the whole team and we look forward to entrusting Paco to you again.

Amazing dog daycare, probably the only one with full trust to the staff here that is so passionate about dogs it is incredible. Throughout the day they share with us photos and videos of our dogs doing different activities. Thank you for caring so much for our dogs!

We were visiting from London and needed a safe, reliable place for our puppy to stay for a few hours until the evening. Waggy Dog Daycare was exactly what we were looking for.

From the very first message, they were incredibly patient, kind, and helpful. Maria, who looked after Pashmak, was so caring and lovely, and made us feel completely at ease.

Throughout Pashmak’s stay, they sent us plenty of photos and videos, which was so reassuring and showed how well she was being cared for.

The team was friendly, professional, and genuinely caring. We had a fantastic experience and would happily trust them with Pashmak again whenever we’re in France. Highly recommended!

Thank you to the whole team for your kindness and professionalism. We especially appreciated the photos and videos sent throughout the day to document our baby Anubis. It was extremely reassuring. This should be a franchise with Waggy locations in every major city.

Coco had a lot of fun during her first day at daycare. Having received lots of photos, we were very reassured.
I recommend it :)

We had an amazing experience with Crèche Waggy during our stay in Paris.

From the moment we arrived, Sara made us feel completely comfortable leaving our dog in their care. You can really tell they love what they do—the environment is safe, fun, and full of attention for each dog. Throughout the day, they kept us updated with photos and messages, which gave us total peace of mind.

What made the biggest difference for us was the freedom it gave us to explore Paris without worrying. Knowing our dog was happy, playing, and well cared for allowed us to fully enjoy the city.

Our dog came back tired, happy, and clearly had a great time—which says everything. We would absolutely recommend this place to anyone visiting Paris with a dog!
A fantastic experience for my dog!! The team is attentive and professional. A huge thank you to Sara for her care and kindness. We'll definitely be back!

I'm thrilled with this dog daycare! The team is caring and truly passionate about the animals' well-being. The little photos they send throughout the day are a lovely touch! Knacki always goes there with enthusiasm and comes back happy. The facilities are clean, safe, and perfectly suited to her needs. It's such a relief to know my companion is in such good hands. I highly recommend it!

My 12-year-old dog has been going there for two months now, and she's like a new lease on life! The dogs are loved, cuddled, and entertained all day long. My dog, who used to be unsociable and very dependent, now arrives happy every morning! Sara and Maria are wonderful, and I highly recommend them!

My 12-year-old dog has been going there for two months now, and it's like she's found a new lease on life! The dogs are loved, cuddled, and kept entertained all day long. My dog, who used to be unsociable and very dependent, now arrives happy every morning! Sara and Maria are wonderful, and I highly recommend them!

Thank you for your feedback.

Yes, we are closed on weekends.

Feel free to book a pet-sitting session during our opening days and hours (Monday-Friday during the day) via our website and come back!
See you soon! 🐶

A wonderful discovery! My little dog loves spending the day here, and the staff know how to make him feel at ease immediately. It's also great to receive little photos throughout the day. Finally, I think the prices are reasonable for a daycare in Paris.

They make coffee every Saturday!!

The atmosphere is cozy and fun with the adorable dogs 🤭
The homemade strawberry milk drink is delicious and so refreshing :) …
Excellent dog-sitting service for my parents' dog; I'd love to have my dog ​​looked after there again sometime! Thank you so much ☺️

Absolutely 5/5!

We went on a Saturday to check out the dog café. Lots of drinks to choose from, for both humans and dogs. The atmosphere is pleasant and welcoming.
The people are really lovely 🤍💛
Thank you so much.

My dog used to stay alone while I was at work and he was bored and not very playful, ever since he started coming to Creche Waggy he’s so much happier and more active! He plays with so many dogs
It has helped him a lot being a more social and happy dog!
My dog loves to go here! He runs toward the place.🙂They take care of my dog of playing, educating, napping, and feeding. All the dogs here are very kind and well behaviored. …
Fafa adores Sarah and Maria! They are trustworthy, responsible and very affectionate.

A fantastic place for dog sitting; the two owners are truly passionate. The dogs are pampered! 🥰
Plus, the place transforms into a dog cafe on Saturdays, perfect for socializing your dog! …
Our dog loves coming here! Between playing with his friends and doing activities with the girls who run the place, he always comes back exhausted and happy! I highly recommend it.

I highly recommend this place! Extremely nice, passionate, and very good with the dogs. My dog can be quite timid and anxious with new environments, but he was so quick to adapt and have fun! They also kept me up to date with photos and videos throughout the day which was so kind. Big thank you to CrecheWaggy. Looking forward to bringing my dog back there often!

I came here with the walkingclub and the place was amazing, super cute and with friendly staff! I totally recommend for someone that has a dog and looks for a daycare service, but also to have a coffee together with other pet owners :)
My dog ​​spent two days here and it went really well. He got lots of exercise and went for walks, and I received photos all day long. Great!

My dog spent the day at the crèche while I was working. He got to play with other dogs, do some agility activity, go for walks…and I received a lot of pictures during the day and saw how he was having fun!
Absolutely fantastic! The girls were wonderful with our dog Moka (a Bam) during a trip to Paris with my partner. They were very attentive to our pet and very responsive, thank you again ☺️

Ukko loves playing with his friends at daycare! He did lots of activities with the girls and came home tired every evening! He asks to go in as soon as we walk by! Can't wait to take him back next winter when we return to Paris.

I highly recommend it 🥰

I don't own a dog, but I love them so much that I went there for coffee on the weekend, and it was great! It was very comfortable because they speak various languages ​​including Korean, French, and English :)

The cookies and drinks were delicious too.

The homemade strawberry ade and the cookies were so affordable and perfect!! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Amazing place! I have been searching for a dog day care in Paris but haven't found any. When I came across Waggy, i was amazed at the facilities, toys, and also at how professional the day care staff was! I am consistently sending my small poodle there. Also they send pictures and videos during the day just to let you know that your child is having fun and safe! The pricing is very very reasonable especially in Paris. My poodle comes back home exhausted after all the fun she has at Waggy! Thank you!

I left my dog ​​at Waggy Daycare for the day, and the experience was perfect! 🐶 The team is professional, passionate, and incredibly caring. Plus, the place is very clean and beautifully decorated. My dog ​​loved the activities (especially the agility and sensory games). I recommend this daycare 1000%, without hesitation! 🐾✨ …
